column1: # Draft G05 (subchapter 6.4): request rid conflicts (409 exists / 409 spent), idempotent replay of answered request (200), DELETE /<sub>/asked/<sha16>, and unreadable asked row -> 429
# Norms: 6.4 Н2, Н3 «подать просьбу» шаги 2–5, Н4 (P/06.4-04, P/06.4-06)
# 1. Active request with same rid (t1-0-1) but different digest -> 409 exists
# Clear operator's rate-limit ledger (sha256("person:operator")[:16] = 084ef0566b7b6a21) via DELETE /testsub2/asked/<sha16>
# 2. Historical command record at objects/testsub2/commands/t1-1-2 with unreadable form or mismatched digest -> 409 spent
# 3. Historical command record with matching unit & digest -> 200 {"answered": ...} without recording a new request
# 4. Unreadable asked row (corrupted rids or at) -> 429 (fail-closed)
